{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
duplicate_count = duplicate_patients.sum()

# Show the first few duplicate patient IDs
duplicate_ids = df[duplicate_patients]['patient_id'].unique()[:5]

# Check the sample_seq for duplicates to see if we can deduplicate
duplicates_with_seq = df[duplicate_patients][['patient_id', 'sample_seq']].sort_values(by='patient_id')

print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {duplicate_count}')
print(f'First few duplicate patient IDs: {duplicate_ids}')
print('\nSample_seq for duplicates:')
duplicates_with_seq.head(10)"}
